ch.title: 更新说明
content: 关于页面新增 App 版本与构建号，并说明云端版本和通信协议版本的含义。
已验证 0.1.4 及以上版本可自动检测、下载并安装更新。
包含完整图标、黄底启动页及后台恢复卡死修复。

en.title: Release Notes
content: Adds the native app version and build number to About, with clear cloud and gateway protocol versions.
Verifies automatic update discovery, download, and installation on Android 0.1.4 and newer.
Includes the complete launcher artwork, amber splash, and foreground recovery fixes.
